title: Minimum Space Wasted From Packaging

monster.name: Volumetric Golem
monster.title: Compressor of Empty Box Space
monster.defeatQuote: Supplier with minimum total wasted box space selected!

description: You have `n` packages with given `packages` weights. You are given `m` suppliers, each offering different box sizes `boxes[j]`. A package fits in a box if weight <= box size. Each package must be packed in a box. Return the minimum total wasted space modulo `10^9 + 7`, or `-1` if no supplier can package all packages.
starterCode:
def minWastedSpace(packages: list[int], boxes: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def minWastedSpace(packages: list[int], boxes: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    import bisect
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    packages.sort()
    total_pkg = sum(packages)
    ans = float('inf')
    for supplier in boxes:
        supplier.sort()
        if supplier[-1] < packages[-1]: continue
        prev_idx = 0
        total_box_space = 0
        for b in supplier:
            idx = bisect.bisect_right(packages, b)
            count = idx - prev_idx
            total_box_space += count * b
            prev_idx = idx
            if idx == len(packages): break
        ans = min(ans, total_box_space - total_pkg)
    return ans % MOD if ans != float('inf') else -1
